wifi issue: Restart the router, check airplane mode, reconnect Wi-Fi.
wifi not working: Restart router and laptop, forget Wi-Fi and reconnect.
slow internet: Check background downloads and restart the router.
password reset: Reset password using the self-service portal.
account locked: Wait 15 minutes or contact IT to unlock your account.
email problem: Logout and login again. Check internet connection.
outlook not opening: Restart Outlook and run repair from Control Panel.
printer issue: Check printer power and reconnect the printer cable.
vpn not connecting: Check internet and restart VPN client.
vpn issue: Ensure correct credentials and stable internet.
blue screen: Restart system and inform IT if it repeats.
laptop overheating: Shut down, clean vents, avoid soft surfaces.
